title: M1 (CH263) J1 window-time extractor pass (MEASUREMENT_M1_CH263.md 9.2): one idempotent chronological pass over the window's decidable captures, writing write-once units/ and status/ files and the state file; to be run every 2 h after the host's pass for the whole window (recurring entry below)
expected_value: the unit set of the prospective measurement; snapshots are kept about 8 days so a missed pass is recoverable only within retention (a slot missing 6 h after its grid time is recorded missing_capture, never rebuilt)
data: host originals ~/arepo/data-dumps/research_lab/snapshots and book_sweeps (read-only); writes data-dumps/research_lab/m1_ch263/
next_action: run again 2 h later until END_UTC + 6 h (2026-12-15T06:00Z); then q0751b_m1_j2
notes: DRAFT (not in jobs/; register only after the registration commit, which must be at least 24 h before REGISTERED_UTC). A queue 'repeat' would re-queue at once and spin, so the recurring mechanism is a cron entry in the style of live_tests3 (not added here): `20 */2 * * * cd ~/arepo/backend && flock -n ~/arepo/run/m1_j1.lock nice -n 19 sh -c 'echo 1000 > /proc/self/oom_score_adj; ulimit -v 1572864; ../.venv/bin/python scripts/run_m1.py j1 --store ../data-dumps/research_lab/m1_ch263 --snapshot-root ../data-dumps/research_lab/snapshots --sweep-root ../data-dumps/research_lab/book_sweeps --pins ../docs/research_lab/seals/M1_pins.json' >> ~/arepo/run/m1_j1.log 2>&1` (the 04:31 pass is the host's; this runs after it). The first run on 2026-11-24 creates the look-back state from every retained capture before REGISTERED_UTC (the count is printed and recorded; fewer than 84 is printed, never filled). Strictly chronological, write-once, refuses on any pin, state-chain or overwrite breach; never reads a resolution, label or outcome field. Never starts before the window: the code itself refuses before REGISTERED_UTC (2026-11-24T00:00:00Z; the first run builds the look-back state, so an early run would leave captures between it and the window out of E3's history), so the cron line may be installed earlier but its passes before then exit 2 and write nothing. `--pins` (the registration commit's M1_pins.json: spec_sha, code_sha, registration_commit_utc) is required and the running code must equal it at every pass; J1 also refuses once the J2 manifest exists. Do not run concurrently with a multi-GB job (memory rule). Code: backend/scripts/run_m1.py with astrolabe/research_lab/m1_spec.py, m1_extract.py, m1_readout.py, m1_analysis.py and the imported m1_j0.py (code_sha in the unit lines); pins checked at start (exit 3 with expected and actual values on a mismatch, exit 2 on a declared refusal).
